{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
{{Quote|Paging Star Tours passenger Mot Worrom. Please pick up the nearest white courtesy comlink. Passenger Mot Worrom to the nearest white courtesy comlink.|Star Tours public address announcer|<ref name="ST2">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>}}
'''Mot Worrom''' was a customer of the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency around the time of an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[raid at Spaceport THX1138]]. A public address announcer paged Morrow in the terminal of the [[Spaceport THX1138|space station]] shortly before the raid, asking the passenger to pick up a courtesy [[comlink]].<ref name="ST2" />

==Behind the scenes==
This name is a reference to a similar announcement made in the original [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']], for Mister [[Tom Morrow]], only with that name spelled backwards.<ref name="9 Facts">{{D23|url=9-out-of-this-world-facts-about-star-tours-30-years-of-continued-adventures|text=9 Out of This World Facts about Star Tours' Over 30 Years of Continued Adventures}}</ref> That original announcement was a reference to a number of [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]] theme park attractions.<ref name="DisneyAtoZ">{{D23|url=a-to-z/tom-morrow|text=Disney A to Z: Tom Morrow}}</ref>
